title: Nilsa's Vanilla Plus
body:
# A Vanilla Plus modpack to play with friends!

Tons of optimization, exploration, and content mods!

Stuff is always changing around, depending on the current vanilla plus feel we are trying to go for.

# Distant Horizons performance

For better performance using Distant Horizons, you should use custom Java arguments in the Modrinth settings: 

1. Settings in the top right
2. Java and memory menu
3. Enable `Custom java arguments`
4. Add `-XX:+UseZGC -XX:+ZGenerational`
5. Close menu and restart Modrinth
